nodes.title: Starter 1: Morgana the Witch
nodes.note: Nếu lá này ở trạng thái Thường hoặc được Triệu hồi Đặc biệt: Bạn có thể thêm 1 "Morganite" Bài Phép từ Bộ bài của bạn vào tay

nodes.title: Starter 2: Succumbing-Song Mo
nodes.note: Bạn có thể xọc xuất lá bài này từ Mộ của mình; thêm 1 lá bài "Morganite" từ Bộ bài của bạn vào tay bạn, sau đó đặt 1 lá bài từ tay bạn xuống đáy Bộ bài.

nodes.title: Primite + 1 Card blue eyes
nodes.note: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Primite" card from your Deck to your hand

nodes.title: Primite + 1 Card blue eyes
nodes.note: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Set 1 "Primite" Spell/Trap from your Deck

cards.name: Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss

nodes.title: B1: Search lên tay
nodes.note: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner from your Deck to your hand

nodes.title: B2: Search lên tay
nodes.note: You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; place 1 "True Light" from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone

nodes.title: B3: Đặt/Úp từ Deck
nodes.note:
● Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or GY.
● Set 1 Spell/Trap directly from your Deck, that specifically lists "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in its text, with a different name from the cards you control and in your GY.

nodes.title: B4: Đặt/Úp từ Deck
nodes.note: Discard 1 card; add 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner, and 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", from your Deck to your hand

nodes.title: B9: Search lên tay
nodes.note: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can show 3 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" in your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY

nodes.title: B11: Link Summon
nodes.note: You can take 1 "Mausoleum of White" from your Deck and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY

nodes.title: B16: Synchro Summon
nodes.note: You can Tribute this Synchro Summoned card; Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon-Type Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position

nodes.title: B17: Kích hiệu ứng
nodes.note: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your hand or GY

nodes.title: B19: Kích hiệu ứng
nodes.note: If you Special Summon "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card.

nodes.title: B21: Synchro Summon
nodes.note: You can Tribute this Synchro Summoned card; Special Summon 1 LIGHT Dragon-Type Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position
